Sixteen riders plus three reserves take part in 20 heats with each rider facing each other once.  The two riders which accumulate the highest amount of points over the heats go straight to the final.  The next four highest point scorers take part in a race-off, with first and second place riders also progressing to the final.  The winner of the final is declared British Under-21 Champion.  Previous winners include former World Champions Mark Loram and Gary Havelock.  The 2009 championship was won by Lewis Bridger who defeated defending champion Tai Woffinden in the final.  Joe Haines was third and Ben Barker finished fourth.
